shape_basic.scope: Eleven project descriptors computed by native extraction and a separately identified independent NumPy specification: count, index bbox min/size XYZ, RAS world centroid XYZ, and pixel area/voxel volume. Never mesh morphology.
shape_basic.primary_full_api_scope: L2/L3/L4 compute the explicit 55 named radiomics features plus matched shape_basic work on both sides, retaining the approved complete-API scope. shape_basic also has a separate L1 native-versus-independent-spec row; it is not presented as an IBSI mesh family or silently combined with one of the six feature families.
shape_basic.independent_reference_specification: Count selected integer voxel indices; integer min/max bbox; arithmetic mean index transformed by original complete affine; determinant/cross-product voxel support measure.

synthetic_generator.intensity: 1 + (((13*x + 17*y + 29*z + seed) XOR ((x*y + 3*z + 7*x*z) mod 251)) mod gray_levels); unsigned integer arithmetic, coordinates zero based
synthetic_generator.roi: Interior ellipsoid: sum(((2*index-(size-1))/(size-3))^2) <= 1 over active dimensions; no 2.5D
synthetic_generator.storage: NIfTI-1 little-endian f64 image/u8 mask, explicit mm sform and deterministic gzip mtime=0; x-fastest arrays in .npy; generated once before measurement
synthetic_generator.license: CC0-1.0 original synthetic input; not clinical data

L1.requires: Native ImageSample.extract(families=[one]) skips unselected matrix/scalar work; the main agent supplies this shared interface before measurement
L1.policy: Time only the selected family through the public array API. Include conversion/binning/matrix/scalar work actually performed; do not claim separately instrumented stages or allocator counts that were not measured. shape_basic is a distinct native-versus-independent-spec row. No formulas for the six families copied into the runner.

L2.input: Fixed already-decoded arrays/ROI; no file I/O, preprocessing or content cache in measured call; both sides include public buffer/image conversion, extraction and table formation

L3.scope: Cohort CSV read, NIfTI image+ROI read, declared clip/crop with affine update, exact 55 named radiomics features plus matched independent shape_basic specification, public DataFrame/diagnostics conversion and CSV/config export. PyRadiomics original only, no mesh/filter/unsupported features.

L4.scope: Complete same-process batch API plus cohort/NIfTI reads and CSV export; unique sample/patient IDs with repeated explicitly disclosed synthetic source image/ROI; cache disabled; outer workers only

cache.policy: Record actual core hit/miss counts, population cost, input/config/implementation identities; no comparison of cached Rust with uncached Python. Pending native hit/miss instrumentation.

L5.policy: Python API measurements here do not establish Python-free CLI startup/install cost; retain independent CLI/no-Python tests and later startup series.

measurement_requires: main-agent approval of exact plan SHA256
immutable matched source/wheel snapshot and hashes
execution.pair_order: Even pair Python then Rust; odd pair Rust then Python. All seven fixed pairs retained, including failures.
execution.worker_lifecycle: Fresh backend interpreter per recorded observation; warm series imports/loads fixtures then one warmup call before timed call. Cold series has no warmup and uses coordinator process-launch-to-exit time including import/call/export/report transport.
execution.parallelism: Native outer n_jobs; reference same-process outer ThreadPoolExecutor. No reference subprocess pools. Inner BLAS/OpenMP/ITK threads=1; requested and effective settings recorded.
execution.peak_memory_metric: Full worker-process lifetime peak resident memory: Windows PeakWorkingSetSize; Linux ru_maxrss converted KiB to bytes. Includes imports, fixture buffers, warmup and timed workload for both backends; not Python traced allocations or process-private memory.
execution.memory_enforcement: Coordinator checks worker resident memory every 20ms; kernel lifetime peak checked after completion. Crossing budget marks operational failure; retain observation/error and do not claim speedup.
execution.file_cache_state: Uncontrolled OS page cache; warmup reads are explicit. Cold means a fresh interpreter, not a claimed cold disk cache.
execution.outputs: Fresh directory per warmup/timed call; no overwrites; bytes and digests retained. No artifact reuse except separately labeled native cache series.
execution.repetition_policy: Do not change seed, datasets, case grid, enabled features, tolerance or repeats after timings. Errors are retained, not dropped. Noise-scale gains are not advertised.

correctness.nonfinite: Exact NaN/Inf/-Inf locations; missing flags cannot hide a finite-value mismatch
correctness.publication: Correctness failures suppress speed claims; performance misses do not change numerical acceptance or Golden fixtures

performance_reporting.speedup: median(reference_seconds)/median(native_seconds), separately per dataset, level, state and thread count
performance_reporting.scaling: Per-dataset native/reference workers=1 versus4; total seconds, ROI/s, speedup/efficiency and stable throughput under fixed memory budget; no pooling across tasks/suites
performance_reporting.release_policy: Disclose missed performance targets and optimize; do not label a correct slow algorithm incorrect or automatically block a scoped experimental release
